name: Rogun: ground motion from NISAR InSAR (GUNW)

colour_scale.meaning: cumulative line-of-sight change since the first date; blue and red are opposite directions along the radar line of sight

caveats: Line-of-sight motion, not purely vertical. Tropospheric delay in high mountains is NOT removed and can mimic 1-3 cm of motion that follows topography; treat single-pair signals with caution. Water, snow and layover are masked. Unwrapping errors are possible in low-coherence areas. Sign convention follows the GUNW product.
display_tip: Show coherence.png as the base, displacement_significant.png on top (colour only where |motion| ≥ 3 cm, same RdBu scale -12..+12 cm), a marker for each spot and the time-series chart. Do not show displacement_los.png as 'motion': its ±2 cm pattern follows the terrain and is not real movement.
story: NISAR InSAR, 2026-06-27 to 2026-10-13 (8 pairs, ionosphere removed): no measurable motion at the Rogun dam beyond about ±3 cm. One 0.36 km² slope 38.7634 N, 69.9185 E moved steadily, +11.6 cm along the radar line of sight (about 1.4 cm every 12 days). Preliminary: to be confirmed with a second orbit and on the ground.
note: From the team's InSAR package (rogun_insar). displacement_los.png left out on purpose: its ±2 cm pattern follows the terrain (troposphere), not real motion.
